notes: Cohen's kappa is undefined (null) when a judge is constant on the compared items; on accepted-only item sets the original judge passes everything, so report flag rates and Gwet's AC1 alongside kappa, and include judge-decided rejected candidates.
Items whose call failed (request/parse/judge-output errors) are excluded per judge and counted under errors; they are never replaced by the deterministic fallback.
privacy: Aggregate metrics only; item ids are hashes. Disagreement CSVs are PRIVATE/internal.
